invariants.description: f_ls matches the exact thresholded first-order step response
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(f_ls - (G_al*max(q_A + q_b - V_lung_stretch_thresh, 0.0)*(1 - np.exp(-t/tau_lung))))) <= 1e-4 * max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(f_ls)))

bc_sweep.rationale: alveolar volume 1.5-4 L (residual to deep inspiration), bronchial/dead-space volume 50-300 mL, threshold 1.5-3.5 L so both sub- and supra-threshold regimes are exercised; tau_lung and G_al bracket the Gee 2023 values by an order of magnitude.
